prerequisite.development: Authorized to continue while acceptance is pending

P11.1: Six separate named public schemas from API design section 4.7, with exact attribute sets, explicit indexes, a coarse ocean-basin allowlist and bounded readonly publication options.
Independent read-only Rabdi adapter using pinned @arkiv-network/sdk 1.0.1, expected creator and current owner, creation flags and expiration.
Bounded task-index lookup filtered by schema, task and wallet. Reports query block, observed head, lag and truncation.
P11.2: Operator adapter publishes task and claim intents with exact public attributes and independently pinned requester and claimant wallets. Claims require a current matching task record.

Each wallet serializes its writes in a durable operator-owned directory. A reservation binds the task or claim intent to a predicted entity key before broadcast. Replays read the reserved key and compare attributes. An ambiguous send or inconsistent key keeps the writer fenced for operator review.
The existing ORCA assignment service was exercised with two separately keyed A2A providers. Each had a distinct claim on the same task, and concurrent assignment attempts produced one winner.

local_checks: Five focused P11.2 Node tests passed for separate writers, duplicate claims, uncertain sends, read-only recovery, and a mismatched returned key.
Two PostgreSQL integration cases passed using loopback PostGIS and local provider processes, covering competing claims and the existing worker hold after an ambiguous chain submission.

live_read_only.note: The query checks a historical H04 task ID against the new P11 schema. The result establishes RPC compatibility with the query. No P11 transaction was sent and no P11 record was read back.

remaining.P11.1: Verify live P11 schema writes and current readback with authorized, separately controlled test wallets.
remaining.P11.2: Connect the new writer to the authenticated task and claim workflow, bind claims to the reviewed institutional trust policy, publish the selected assignment reference, and verify live multi-wallet receipts and readback. The current operator adapter and historical backend workflow are both available for their respective scopes.
remaining.P11.3: Connect approved artifact and review publications, pagination and live dashboard timeline.
remaining.P11.4: Cross-check independent verifier against live records and capture expiry, outage, nonce and ambiguous-submission recovery.
